messages:
viv-liu: Heads-up — drafted a lightweight battlecard iteration focused on 'serving-first' vs cloud AI platforms and infra vendors. Need quick feedback on benchmark framing, webinar hooks, and inbound routing. Filing here for async.

priya-k: Link to the draft: https://redwood.internal/docs/battlecards/serving-first-draft (comments enabled). High-level suggestions: emphasize predictable economics, fallback story, and observability-first. Keep claims specific and verifiable.

sam-g: Quick ask — for the latency claim vs vendor X can we show a simple p99 comparison for 2k tokens? Sales wants a solid soundbite: "~3x lower p99 on real conv prompts" if we can back it.

jon-eng: Attaching internal perf snapshot below (pulling from last week's bench). Will paste a tiny table.

jon-eng: ```
model        | seq=512 p50/ms | seq=512 p99/ms | seq=2048 p50/ms | seq=2048 p99/ms
redwood-opt  | 45             | 210            | 180             | 820
vendor-X-std | 60             | 620            | 240             | 2600
```

casey-sales: Nice. Two asks from SDRs: 1) Add a 1-liner for procurement: "Why not just buy GPUs?" — call out managed ops + rollout + audits. 2) Routing: we need an inbound flag to mark enterprise prospects who cite "on-prem" or "SLA" so AE gets dedicated play.

priya-k: For the battlecard copy I propose these short bullets: 
- "Predictable serving economics: measurable unit cost with batching + caching."
- "Graceful degradation: automatic routing to compatible variants during capacity pressure."
- "Production observability: token-level tracing and model-level regression alerts."
Include concrete numbers from Jon's table where relevant.

sam-g: For webinar hook: run a 10-min live demo showing 2 scenarios: normal steady traffic + simulated infra failure where fallback keeps app live. Title idea: "Keeping LLM features online: economics, fallbacks, and proofs."

casey-sales: Also add one slide: procurement objection script + TCO delta example. Link to TCO template: https://redwood.internal/sales/tco-template.xlsx

ops-bot: Reminder: webinar slot tentatively booked Wed 10:00am PT. Register by EOD Tue to lock recording. :calendar:

viv-liu: Plan / next steps: Jon to inline a short note about bench methodology (datasets, seed prompts), Priya to update battlecard copy + create 2-sentence elevator, Casey to draft procurement Qs and inbound routing criteria, Sam to draft webinar outline. Aim to ship updated doc by Thu EOD. Thanks all. :sparkles:
